phrases.text: Sir, apne paas aane waale 10 patients mein se
ke patients itne kyun badh rahe hain? Sir, kya kaaran hai?
Aaye din diabetes ke patient badhne ka
Yaani prameh yeh kisko hota hai?
Jo pehle ke zamaane mein rais hote the,
jinke paas zyada paisa hota hai.
Jisko chinta rahegi, jisko vyapaar ki chinta rahegi,
aisa Charakacharya ji ne kaha hai.
pehle se hi is baare mein sambhashan
diabetes hai, iska matlab use chinta hai.
Woh chinta mein apna vyapaar karta hai,
iska jo zyada prayog karta hai,
gramya-audaka-anupa-rasah payamsi, jo gaay, bhains hai,
unke kaaran jo dahi, doodh hote hain,
nayi fasal, jo anna abhi-abhi nikle hue hain.
Pichhle saal ke chaawal, puraane chaawal ka use karein.
Iska matlab naye chaawal ka use
nahi karna chahiye, naye anaaj ka use nahi karna chahiye,
Yeh bhi bataya hai ki guda-vaikritam cha,
diabetes ho sakta hai, iske baare mein
kai logon ko stress hota hai,
jinke paas zyada paisa hota hai,
inke paas zyada sukh hota hai,
Iska matlab sabhi log sukhi hain,
yahi ek kaaran maana ja sakta hai.
